item_name: Rothco GI Style Aluminum Canteen Cup
item_short_desc: Rothco’s GI Style Aluminum Canteen Cup is a versatile and essential piece of outdoor gear. Crafted from durable aluminum, this canteen cup has a capacity of 24 ounces, making it perfect for holding beverages or preparing meals on the go. The butterfly handle design ensures a secure and comfortable grip, even when the cup is hot. This canteen cup is designed to fit under all 1-quart plastic canteens, providing a compact and efficient solution for your hydration needs.
